## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Safety and compatibility

- What Git states and edge cases are affected?
- Could this change modify repository data, history, credentials, settings, or recovery information?
- Are migrations or compatibility notes required?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Added or updated regression tests
- [ ] Completed relevant Windows smoke-test steps
- [ ] Updated documentation, translations, and `CHANGELOG.md` when applicable
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, private repository data, build output, or local databases are included
